_comment: Administrative rollup for Hurricane Helene, built from the association keys the
pipeline actually produced (58 keys over 110 observations), not from an imagined
gazetteer. Deliberately narrow: this covers the six states Helene touched. A general
gazetteer is only worth building if rollup is shown to fix fragmentation first.
Two axes fragment independently, and both are handled here:
TYPE      the same event is classified Floods / Storm / Mudslides across articles,
so Floods|florida and Storm|florida are the same stream. collapse_type
drops the type from the key entirely.
PLACE     city and county mentions roll up to their state; multi-state and regional
phrases roll up to __aggregate__, which is NOT a state -- it is the
national total, and the vector-state work treats it as a sum row rather
Ground truth is keyed on states, so a stream below state level cannot be scored; the
rollup is what makes per-state measurement possible at all.

Tail added 2026-08-10 from the keys the rollup run left unmapped -- enumerated by running it, not guessed in advance. Places outside the affected states (poland, iran, japan, cameroon) are deliberately NOT mapped: they are other events leaking through the gate, and mapping them would hide a real contamination problem.
